description: This file contains utility functions for managing project dependencies, filtering projects, building project closures, and collecting test files within a Playwright testing framework setup.

methods.name: wildcardPatternToRegExp
methods.description: Converts a wildcard pattern with '*' into a RegExp object.

methods.name: filterProjects
methods.description: Filters a list of projects based on provided project names or patterns, throwing errors if no matches are found.

methods.name: buildTeardownToSetupsMap
methods.description: Builds a map linking teardown projects to their associated setup projects.

methods.name: buildProjectsClosure
methods.description: Builds a closure of projects, identifying dependencies and detecting circular dependencies.

methods.name: findTopLevelProjects
methods.description: Finds top-level projects from the configuration.

methods.name: buildDependentProjects
methods.description: Builds a set of projects that depend on the given projects, including transitive dependencies.

methods.name: collectFilesForProject
methods.description: Collects test files for a given project, respecting test match patterns and ignore rules.
